title: Data Pipeline (strict linear dependency chain)

requirements.text: Ingest the raw records from the upstream source into a staging area (first stage, no prerequisites)
Validate the ingested records against the schema, rejecting malformed rows; depends on the ingest stage
Transform the validated records into the canonical internal format; depends on the validate stage
Deduplicate the transformed records, removing exact and near-duplicate entries; depends on the transform stage
Load the deduplicated records into the target warehouse; depends on the deduplicate stage
Notify downstream consumers that fresh data is available; depends on the load stage

known_issues: strict linear chain of 6 stages where each explicitly depends on the immediately prior stage; stresses dependency ordering and backward-reference (depends_on_index) resolution
hallucination_traps: must not invent forward references or dependencies on later stages
must not parallelize or reorder stages; must not add dependencies not stated in the text
notes: Every task except the first should depend on the immediately prior one, in creation order (ingest -> validate -> transform -> deduplicate -> load -> notify). depends_on_index must always point backward to the preceding task.
